desktop.notes:
• Click an album's number in the sidebar (or ▦ Whole album in the album bar) - every photo of it: this folder, your other folders and the Library (Curish too). Photos of this folder are bright; double-click one to jump to it, any other opens in Explorer.
• Clicking the album itself still shows only this folder's photos of it. An album with none here opens the whole album straight away.
